askIntro: Start with one honest question. Aletheia will slow the moment down and help you discern clearly.
modeGuidancePreview: Keep this view focused. Expand when you want deeper checks, blind spots, and maturity signals.
greetingIntent: Let's choose one wise next step today.
whatNextBody: Aletheia is choosing one wise next action first. Ask and mode controls stay easy to reach when you want to begin something new.
askOneQuestionBody: Start with the pressure or decision you are carrying right now.
askNewQuestionBody: The Companion input and wisdom modes stay close at hand.
notificationPromptBody: Receive one quiet daily wisdom prompt.
syncDevicesBody: Keep decisions and reflections across devices.
startDecisionBody: Track a high-stakes choice over time.
modeShapesCounsel: mode is shaping this counsel around
shareAnswerPrompt: Share Aletheia with someone who may benefit from this kind of counsel.
sharePrivacyNote: This shares the app link only, not your question or Aletheia's private answer.
formationNote: These are quiet signs of formation, not points to chase. The first milestone usually begins with saving one reflection.
milestoneShareTitle: Know someone making a major decision?
milestoneShareBody: You can invite them to Aletheia without sharing anything private from your account.
welcomeCounsel: Bring a real decision, pressure, or money question. I will answer from the curated wisdom library, with emotional clarity and no financial promises.
trustScriptureBody: Scripture references come from Aletheia's curated wisdom library. If a verse appears, you can tap it to see context and why it matters.
trustBoundaryBody: Aletheia will not promise outcomes, predict markets, claim divine certainty, or replace qualified financial, legal, tax, medical, or pastoral counsel.
trustMemoryBody: Signed-in memory helps continuity across decisions, reflections, counsel, and rules of life. It should make guidance more personal without exposing private details unnecessarily.
trustConnectedDataBody: Future health, finance, or device integrations should be permission-by-permission, off by default, and limited to the exact data the user chooses to connect.

money.label: Money
money.intent: Steward resources with peace and clarity.
money.useWhen: Use for spending, debt, saving, investing, financial anxiety, or comparison.
prompts: How do I build wealth without greed?
What does wisdom say about debt?
How do I stop comparing myself financially?

work.label: Work
work.intent: Discern work, calling, leadership, and sustainable ambition.
work.focus: Career moves, leadership, business, burnout, vocation
work.useWhen: Use for job decisions, business ideas, leadership pressure, burnout, or ambition.
prompts: Should I leave my stable job?
How do I know if ambition is healthy?
Should I start this business now?

purpose.label: Purpose
purpose.intent: Slow down and discern the person this decision forms.
purpose.focus: Identity, direction, anxiety, values, long-term clarity
purpose.useWhen: Use when the real question is identity, direction, peace, timing, or values.
prompts: How do I make a decision when I feel unclear?
What if I am chasing success for the wrong reasons?
How do I find peace about my next step?

generosity.label: Generosity
generosity.intent: Give freely without guilt, pressure, or performance.
generosity.focus: Giving, family support, charity, boundaries, sustainability
generosity.useWhen: Use for giving, tithing, helping family, boundaries, or sustainable generosity.
prompts: How do I give without guilt or pressure?
Should I help family financially again?
How much generosity is sustainable for me?

reduce_anxiety.label: Reduce anxiety
reduce_anxiety.body: Move from pressure into calmer trust before acting.
reduce_anxiety.companionPrompt: Help me move from anxiety to steady trust in this situation.
reduce_anxiety.decisionsPrompt: What is one calmer next step I can take before making this decision?

improve_stewardship.label: Improve stewardship
improve_stewardship.body: Shape money and work choices around faithful responsibility.
improve_stewardship.companionPrompt: How can I practice faithful stewardship with today's money and work choices?
improve_stewardship.decisionsPrompt: Which option best reflects faithful stewardship over comfort or image?

wait_with_peace.label: Wait with peace
wait_with_peace.body: Slow urgency and make room for prayer, facts, and counsel.
wait_with_peace.companionPrompt: Guide me to wait with peace instead of urgency in this pressure.
wait_with_peace.decisionsPrompt: How long should I wait before acting so I can discern with peace?

build_consistency.label: Build consistency
build_consistency.body: Practice small rhythms that make wisdom repeatable.
build_consistency.companionPrompt: Give me one small daily rhythm to stay consistent this week.
build_consistency.decisionsPrompt: What repeatable step can keep this decision process consistent over time?

seek_counsel.label: Seek counsel wisely
seek_counsel.body: Invite the right trusted voice before a major step.
seek_counsel.companionPrompt: Who should I invite into counsel for this decision, and what should I ask them?
seek_counsel.decisionsPrompt: What counsel checkpoint should I set before finalizing this decision?

supportMission.title: Support the mission
supportMission.summary: Help keep Aletheia free, trustworthy, multilingual, and deeply useful.
supportMission.body: Optional support helps us keep Aletheia calm, trustworthy, multilingual, and available to people seeking wisdom for money, work, purpose, and stewardship.
supportMission.impactAi: AI and retrieval costs for thoughtful wisdom responses
supportMission.impactTranslations: public-domain scripture, translation polish, and language support
supportMission.impactAccess: free access for people making high-pressure decisions
supportMission.impactReliability: hosting, notifications, privacy, and reliability work
supportMission.cardWallet: Card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay
supportMission.notConfigured: Support links are being prepared. Aletheia remains fully usable while this is set up.
supportMission.trustNote: Giving is optional. It never changes the counsel you receive, and payment details are handled by the payment provider, not by Aletheia.
supportMission.impactSummary: Keep the funding details collapsed until you want the context.

confirm.signOut: Sign out? Private account data will be hidden from this device. Your synced account data stays safe and returns when you sign back in.
confirm.clearGuestWorkspace: Clear local guest conversations, decisions, reflections, counsel contacts, and rules from this device? This does not delete any signed-in account data.
confirm.deleteJournalEntry: Are you sure you want to delete this journal entry? This cannot be undone.
confirm.turnOffNotifications: Are you sure you want to turn off daily wisdom notifications? You will no longer receive gentle reminders for reflection.
confirm.deleteDecision:
Delete "{title}"?

This will permanently remove this decision and all its timeline events. This cannot be undone.
confirm.shareDecisionWithCounsel:
Share "{decision}" with {contact}?

They will be able to view the decision summary you created. Your private journal entries and chats remain private.
confirm.shareMultipleDecisionsWithCounsel:
Share {count} {item} with {contact}?

They will be able to view decision summaries. Your private journal entries and chats remain private.
confirm.removeFromCounselCircle:
Remove {name} from your Counsel Circle?

They will no longer be able to view future shared summaries.
confirm.deleteCounselSummary: Are you sure you want to delete this counsel summary? This cannot be undone.
confirm.closeDecision: Are you sure you want to close this decision? You can still view it in the timeline, but it will no longer appear in active decisions.
